# Simplified Chinese: 参考人声 · MP3 / MP4 等
English: Reference voice · MP3, MP4 and more
Traditional Chinese: 參考人聲 · MP3 / MP4 等

# Simplified Chinese: 先听参考片段 / 收藏音色
English: Preview or save a reference voice
Traditional Chinese: 先聽參考片段／收藏音色

# Simplified Chinese: 从第几秒开始寻找清晰讲话
Traditional Chinese: 從第幾秒開始尋找清晰語音

# Simplified Chinese: 参考片段（可拖动裁剪，保留 3–25 秒）
English: Reference clip (drag to trim to 3–25 seconds)
Traditional Chinese: 參考片段（可拖曳裁剪，保留 3–25 秒）

# Simplified Chinese: 参考片段原话（留空自动识别）
Traditional Chinese: 參考片段原文（留空自動辨識）

English: Enter the text to read aloud…

# Simplified Chinese: 上传歌曲或视频 → 翻唱
English: Upload a song or video for a cover
Traditional Chinese: 上傳歌曲或影片 → 翻唱

# Simplified Chinese: 输入为视频时同时导出 MP4
English: Export MP4 when the input is a video
Traditional Chinese: 輸入為影片時一併匯出 MP4

# Simplified Chinese: 满意了，沿用这段试听生成整首
English: Apply preview settings to the full song
Traditional Chinese: 沿用試聽設定生成整首

English: Ready for text or a song.

# Simplified Chinese: 生成结果 · AI 合成
Traditional Chinese: 生成結果 · AI 合成

# Simplified Chinese: 载入后在“生成作品”中播放或下载。作品永久保留；局部修改素材保留 7 天，总量上限约 5 GB，超出后先清理旧素材。
English: Play or download loaded projects in Create. Finished projects stay saved. Source files for partial edits are kept for up to 7 days, with a storage limit of about 5 GB.
Traditional Chinese: 載入後可在「製作作品」中播放或下載。完成的作品會永久保留；局部修改素材保留 7 天，上限約 5 GB，超出後會優先清理舊素材。

# Simplified Chinese: 只重做这个区间（最多 120 秒）
English: Redo only this section (up to 120 seconds)
Traditional Chinese: 只重做這個區間（最多 120 秒）

English: Use selected preview for full song
Traditional Chinese: 使用選取的試聽片段生成整首

# Simplified Chinese: 参考音色取自 1974 年 4 月 10 日联合国大会讲话。
English: The reference voice comes from the UN General Assembly speech of April 10, 1974.
Traditional Chinese: 參考音色取自 1974 年 4 月 10 日聯合國大會演講。

# Simplified Chinese: 打开工作室时检查并安装新版，然后进入网页。离线时会继续打开当前版本。
English: Check for and install updates before opening the app. The current version opens when offline.
Traditional Chinese: 開啟工作室時會檢查並安裝新版，再開啟介面。離線時仍可開啟目前版本。

English: You can also check for updates manually.

# Simplified Chinese: 安装已下载更新并重启
Traditional Chinese: 安裝已下載的更新並重新啟動

English: Roll back to the previous version

# Simplified Chinese: 更新前先停止生成。安装和回退会关闭并重新打开工作室，作品、收藏音色和模型不受影响。回退后，自动更新会等待更高版本。
English: Stop generation before updating. Installing or rolling back restarts the studio and keeps your work, saved voices and models. After a rollback, automatic updates wait for a newer release.
Traditional Chinese: 更新前請先停止生成。安裝和還原會重新開啟工作室，並保留作品、收藏音色與模型。還原後，自動更新會等待更高版本。

# Simplified Chinese: 诊断报告（不含录音、输入文字和作品）
English: Diagnostic report (excludes recordings, text and projects)
Traditional Chinese: 診斷報告（不含錄音、輸入文字和作品）

# Simplified Chinese: 显存不足：关闭其他显卡程序，选择“6 GB 节省显存”。下载失败：检查网络后重试，保留已有缓存。无法启动：在启动器点击“修复安装”。
English: Low VRAM? Close other GPU apps and choose 6 GB · Low VRAM. If a download fails, check your connection and retry. If the app won't open, use Repair in the launcher.
Traditional Chinese: 顯示記憶體不足時，請關閉其他使用 GPU 的程式，並選擇「6 GB · 節省顯示記憶體」。下載失敗時，請檢查網路後重試。無法啟動時，請在啟動器中選擇「修復安裝」。

# Simplified Chinese: 所有输出均为 AI 合成，不能作为本人真实录音。素材与生成均在本机处理。
English: All output is AI-generated. Files and generation are processed locally.
Traditional Chinese: 所有輸出均為 AI 合成。素材與生成均在本機處理。
